newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit stays in tight range in sluggish trading.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit stays in tight range in sluggish trading.

text.p: The ringgit stayed in a tight 10-point range against the dollar throughout Friday's session as trading remained sluggish ahead of the year-end holiday season, dealers said.
Some light commercial demand for the dollar had depressed the ringgit in the morning.

"Dollar/ringgit is still very much in range though there was some covering of positions as a lot of overseas centres will be closed for most of next week," said a dealer with a major Malaysian bank. He said muted dollar/majors movement also contributed to the tight dollar/ringgit trading.
Dealers said that barring any sharp fluctuation in dollar/majors, the ringgit is expected to trade between 2.5230 and 2.5280 a dollar for the rest of the year.
They added that with most interbank players already closing their books for the year, activity would continue to be dominated by commercial interest.
At 0900 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5255/65 a dollar against 2.5238/48 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Thursday.
